title: rosa gallica var. liostyla
intro: Rosa gallica var. liostyla, commonly known as the French lavender rose, is a fragrant, pink-hued species of rose plant that belongs to the family Rosaceae. The health benefits of Rosa gallica var. liostyla include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve sleep quality due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in aromatherapy to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and alleviate anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Rosa gallica var. liostyla include fragrant compounds such as geraniol, linalool, and β-pinene, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
